name: Cinder Lance
text: A beam of fire pierces every foe in a line and sets them burning
lore: The pyre-keepers lit the chapel's lamps from across the nave with a single thrown flame. The lamps are long cold, but the trick outlived them: held long enough, the flame learns to go through things.

name: Pyre Seal
text: A seal at your feet erupts in a ring of flame and leaves the ground burning
lore: The sextons chalked this seal beneath the pyres so that nothing laid on them would rise half-burnt. It does not ask what stands in its circle. It only waits one heartbeat, and then it answers.

name: Rime Shards
text: Five shards of ice fly in a fan, each one chilling what it strikes
lore: Breath held too long in the ossuary's cold turns to needles. A frost-caller learns to spit them back a fistful at a time, and each one steals a little of the warmth the dead still envy.

name: Glacial Wall
text: A wall of ice stops foes and their shots, but not your bolts, then shatters on those near it
lore: Pilgrims cornered in the lower crypts prayed for a wall between them and the dead. The frost answered a few of them. It never held for long, and it never fell quietly.

name: Arc
text: Lightning strikes the nearest foe and leaps to three more
lore: The first spell a storm-caller learns is how to let the lightning choose. It always finds the nearest thing that breathes, and it is never satisfied with just one.

name: Static Mantle
text: For six seconds, any foe that touches you is shocked and thrown back
lore: Wrap yourself in the storm and it guards you jealously. Whatever reaches for you is struck and flung away; the storm has never liked to share what it holds.

name: Consecrate
text: Holy ground at your feet sears the foes who stand in it and lays them open; standing in it heals you a little
lore: The Wardens blessed their chapel's floor before a single grave was cut in it. A little of that blessing sleeps in the stone still, and a word wakes it: for a few breaths, the ground remembers whose it was.

name: Judgement
text: A moment's warning, then a pillar of light falls on the strongest foe in reach
lore: The abbesses kept a light for the worst of the dead, and let it fall only once they were sure. It still chooses the strongest thing in the room, and it is still in no hurry to forgive.

name: Wardlight
text: Six motes of light circle you, breaking the shots they meet and searing the foes they touch
lore: Pilgrims walking the crypts at night carried candles that would not go out, and the dark learned to keep its distance. A mage can carry the flames without the candles.

name: Hex Bolt
text: A slow dark bolt that hexes what it strikes: every blow on a hexed foe gives you back mana
lore: The dead remember what they were owed. A bolt of their grudge clings to whatever it strikes, and every blow that follows it draws back a little of what was taken.

name: Grasp of the Grave
text: Hands rise from the floor where you aim and hold every foe there, hexed
lore: The buried do not like to be walked over. Asked nicely, they will hold whoever stands above them for as long as the asking lasts, and a little longer out of spite.

name: The Ferryman's Toll
text: Mark the nearest foe with the Ferryman's due: blows on it give back mana, and if it falls it pays an obol and its hex spreads
lore: Every soul crosses with a coin on its tongue. Mark a foe with the Ferryman's due and it pays while it lives; if it falls with the mark still on it, the coin is yours.
